hypotheses.T0_manual_two_qk_attention_jvp_is_exact: Manual two-QK/current-value attention writes and JVPs match native forward/autograd with maximum relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.T1_attention_layer_paths_recompose_exact: The 32 I/A layer-subset paths recompose the independent unexpanded full suffix JVP with maximum sitewise relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.T2_full_analytic_jvp_predicts_finite_eff: The full path sum predicts the scale-0.02 dynamic-attention finite effect with fidelity at least 0.99 on every corpus.
hypotheses.T3_mlp_identity_path_explains_most_effec: The no-attention-response path retains at least 0.94 analytic fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.T4_four_attention_paths_are_high_fidelit: Four discovery-frozen attention paths retain at least 0.98 analytic fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.T5_compact_combined_program_predicts_nat: Replacing the identity path by the frozen four-path MLP approximation while retaining the top four attention paths predicts the finite native effect with at least 0.94 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.T6_attention_paths_beat_random: At budget four, the frozen attention program exceeds the identity-plus-random-path 95th percentile by at least 0.01 on every corpus.
hypotheses.T7_attention_program_transfers_ood: Frozen four-path analytic fidelity on each OOD corpus is within 0.03 of FineWeb.
hypotheses.T8_attention_program_is_low_order: At least three of the frozen top-four paths use attention response in at most one layer.
hypotheses.T9_context_specific_attention_selection_: At budget four, the per-example oracle exceeds the frozen program by less than 0.02 on every corpus.
